method: Each replica route was rendered in Chromium at the same three viewports used for the reference capture, screenshotted full-page, and compared pixel by pixel with pixelmatch (threshold 0.18, anti-aliasing ignored). Images of differing height are padded to a common canvas, so a longer or shorter page counts as a difference rather than being cropped away. Comparison height is capped at 6000px.

rawDesktopDifferenceRatio.note: Measured with the replica's demonstration banner left in place, so every row below it is displaced relative to the original. Reported for completeness; the banner-aligned figure below is the better measure of layout fidelity.

expectedDifferences: A demonstration banner runs across the top of every replica page. The original has no such banner, so every page differs by that strip and everything below it is displaced downwards.
The official NPIP wordmark, the National Emblem and the NIC logo are replaced by a neutral placeholder mark, deliberately, so the replica cannot be mistaken for the official service.
The home page hero on the original is a photographic carousel. The replica uses a flat gradient: the photograph is government material that is not ours to redistribute.
Figures differ because the replica reports its own synthetic database, not the original's live statistics.
The original renders its select controls through the Chosen jQuery widget. The replica uses native selects, which the browser paints differently.
honesty: These are measured pixel ratios from the images in reference_pages/screenshots/ and replica_screenshots/, with the diffs in comparison/. No similarity figure in this project is asserted without one of these measurements behind it, and no page is claimed to match the original exactly.
